description: Quetiapine ER, marketed as Seroquel XR, is an atypical antipsychotic that works primarily by antagonizing dopamine D2 and serotonin 5-HT2A receptors, among other targets. The extended-release formulation allows for once-daily dosing, maintaining therapeutic plasma levels over 24 hours. It is approved for the treatment of schizophrenia, bipolar mania and depression, and as adjunctive therapy for major depressive disorder.
